question: What can the official NFRDI FY 2023 report support about Lake Taal and Pansipit River fish records, dates, and coverage?

study.sourceType: Official government institute annual report summarizing a landed-catch survey under a Taal Lake and Pansipit River stock-assessment project.
study.reportPeriod: The report covers NFRDI activities from 1 January through 31 December 2023; this does not by itself establish the field period of every Taal result.

assessment.validUse: Cited, historical, aggregate landed-catch context for the named lake and river. The Pansipit top-five names and reported catch period can guide follow-up to the underlying station/month records.
notSupported: The Lake Taal total is internally inconsistent: the report says 'Forty-one (49)', then 46 finfish plus three other aquatic taxa, which sums to 49. Do not silently choose either 41 or 49 as a validated inventory total.
The report does not provide the complete species list, field methods, individual species dates, or species-by-landing-center detail in its short annual-report summary.
Pansipit landing centers are not stated to be exact fish-capture locations; do not turn their names or counts into map points or riverwide distribution claims.
Landed-catch records do not prove current wild presence, abundance, habitat residency, or complete species coverage.
Catch ranking is not natural diet or bait-effectiveness evidence and is not safety, fishing-access, or legal guidance.
assessment.taxonomicHandling: Keep the report's five Pansipit names as source-reported labels until independently crosswalked against a current taxonomic authority. No identities were silently revised.
assessment.geography: The report names Lake Taal and Pansipit River at waterbody level only. The five Pansipit landing centers are not individually linked to species records in the summary.
assessment.relevanceToCoveragePlan: This strengthens the historical-catch evidence lane for L1 but does not add a species-level occurrence inventory. Request or locate the underlying monthly and landing-center records before any stronger species/site assertions.

accessAndReuse.officialRepositoryMetadata: The NFRDI Knowledge Products Repository identifies the item as DA-NFRDI Annual Report 2023, issued 2024, and provides an official PDF download.
accessAndReuse.license: No open license or explicit redistribution permission for the report or underlying data was identified.
accessAndReuse.disposition: Reviewed the publisher-hosted PDF text through the web reader. No local PDF, page image, full table, photograph, or article prose was copied. This research summary is not permission to reproduce the report or its underlying dataset. No request was sent.

nextAction: National rollout step 398: seek an authorized, species-by-date and landing-site extract or an independently reusable primary CALABARZON inland-water survey; keep annual-report species mentions in the historical catch lane only.

sources.supports: Official repository record identifying the DA-NFRDI Annual Report 2023, its 2024 issue year, repository ownership, and the available PDF file.
Report copyright line and the Taal Lake/Pansipit River catch-summary text (printed pages 24-25).
